2026_01_NYJ_TEN.headline: Geno Smith’s Jets return begins against a Tennessee defense that can attack missing depth
2026_01_NYJ_TEN.paragraph1: Geno Smith is set to start for the Jets again after a decade away from the franchise, but New York enters Tennessee without Tim Patrick and Joseph Ossai, with Kene Nwangwu and D’Angelo Ponds doubtful. The Titans have their own absence with Cedric Gray out. New York needs Smith to keep the offense organized and avoid giving Tennessee extra possessions, while the Titans can test the Jets’ depth by making them defend the full width of the field and finish tackles.
2026_01_NYJ_TEN.model_rationale: New York’s organization around Smith can stabilize the offense, while Tennessee’s best opening is to press the Jets’ reduced depth and force extended defensive possessions.
